ask: How did my posts do over the last 30 days?

steps.why: The brand's timezone, to work out today's date there, so the 30 days end now.
What went out, with numbers, over 30 days counted back from now. Zeros on posts under about a week old mean not synced yet: leave them out of rankings.
status is exact: published leaves out posts that went out on only some accounts. Read those too, count them apart, and say so.

say: Acme, last 30 days: 14 posts went out in full, 12 on LinkedIn and 2 on X, and 1 more went out on only some of its accounts. Your two best on LinkedIn were both customer stories. 3 posts from this week aren't synced yet, so they're left out. Want next week's drafts to lean that way?
never: Counting only fully published posts as everything that went out.
Comparing networks with fewer than 5 posts.
